answer: Two-Sided Quote Duty: earning weight requires standing liquidity - each identity posts both a bid and an ask each epoch, spread capped by a willow band that flexes with measured volatility, and a synthetic taker randomly lifts one side. Refusal to deliver against a lifted quote, or quoting one side only, zeroes the epoch. The inventory delta must reconcile against externally signed fills, so colluders trading only among themselves leave no outside fills, their profit book stays a fable and their weight collapses; honest makers pay real spread risk each round.
